title: tlogf helper is a silent no-op (expectf with true never emits)
detail: core:testing's expectf records its message only on failure; with cond=true it emits nothing, so tlogf is dead. The surge/idle-loss diagnostic it claims to log is silently lost — misleading infra with no debuggability payoff.
recommended_fix: Body the helper with fmt.eprintln(fmt.aprintf(format, ..args)) (or core:fmt to stderr), or delete tlogf and its sole call. Do not ship a logging helper that prints nothing.
